bound_by: paper evaluator (overseer session), after population, admission, disposal, reopen and replay were frozen; types read from the accepted population surface only. Method: for each question a set of surface types judged relevant to its required semantics, then every ordered pair of those types under each of the surface's three relation types, with a fixed field projection per type. A first hand-picked draft (results/native-query-binding.draft-01.json, 38 cases) returned no row for CQ-03 and was replaced by the exhaustive form; a second draft (draft-02.json) included BibliographicSource in CQ-04's type set, which bound 75 citation rows with no bearing on the mechanism question, and that type was removed from CQ-04 before freezing, so that a question's rows depend on the graph and not on the evaluator's guess of which type pairs the producer connected. Event types cannot be relation endpoints and are not bound.
